messages.最大威力41の高威力で火傷を撒き、解析Ⅳで加重値3の広域になる、憤怒貫通の火傷E: A Wrath Pierce Burn E.G.O that spreads Burn with high power up to 41 and becomes a 3-Attack-Weight multi-target attack at Threadspin Ⅳ.
messages.高威力: 1コインでマッチ威力14〜36(解析Ⅲは19〜41)。基本威力が低いの: **High power**: A single Coin with Clash Power 14–36 (19–41 at Threadspin Ⅲ). Its Base Power is low, so power drops sharply on Tails.
messages.火傷の付与: 的中時に憤怒共鳴数÷2(解析Ⅲは憤怒共鳴数)の火傷を付与。表面的中: **Inflicting Burn**: On hit, inflicts Burn equal to Wrath Resonance ÷ 2 (Wrath Resonance at Threadspin Ⅲ). On Heads Hit (at the end of a Heads attack at Threadspin Ⅳ), inflicts 3 Burn (5 at Threadspin Ⅳ) on 3 random enemies.
messages.混乱区間前進: 解析Ⅲから、表面的中時にダメージ量の40%分、混乱区間を進める。: **Stagger Threshold shift**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, shifts the Stagger Threshold by 40% of the damage dealt on Heads Hit.
messages.飛び散る火花: 火傷のある敵への攻撃的中時、ランダムな敵3名に火傷1を付与する。: **Passive — Shower of Fire**: When an attack hits an enemy with Burn, inflicts 1 Burn on 3 random enemies. It works well alongside multi-Coin Burn Identities.
messages.最後方狙い: 一般戦闘では最後方の対象を攻撃するため、味方のマッチ順が変わる。: **Targets the rearmost**: In regular battles, it attacks the rearmost target, changing allies' Clash order.
messages.憤怒共鳴を稼げる火傷編成で、精神力が高い状態で撃つ。精神力が低いと裏面が出やすく: Use it with high SP in a Burn team that can build Wrath Resonance. With low SP, Tails becomes more likely and its low Base Power hurts.
messages.解析Ⅲで威力が揃い、マッチ目的ならここで十分。広域で火傷を撒くなら解析Ⅳが必要。: Its power is complete at Threadspin Ⅲ, which is enough for Clashing. To spread Burn across multiple targets, Threadspin Ⅳ is required.
messages.侵蝕スキルは打撃で、使用時に体力を最大値の10%減らし、敵味方全員に火傷を付与す: The Corrosion skill is Blunt, costs 10% of her max HP on use, and inflicts Burn on every ally and enemy.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が14から19になり、混乱区間前進が付く。火傷が憤怒共鳴数ぶんに増: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 14 to 19, and the Stagger Threshold shift is added. Burn increases to Wrath Resonance.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が3になって広域化し、ランダム3名への火傷が5に増える。: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 3 for multi-target attacks, and the Burn on 3 random enemies increases to 5.
messages.南部リウ協会4課: S1(色欲)・S2(憤怒)・S3(嫉妬)で必要資源をすべて出: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0806)**: S1 (Lust), S2 (Wrath), and S3 (Envy) supply all required affinities, and all of her skills inflict Burn.
messages.南部シ協会5課: S1(嫉妬)・S2(色欲)・S3(憤怒)で必要資源を出せ、体力: **[Shi Assoc. South Section 5](persona:0803)**: S1 (Envy), S2 (Lust), and S3 (Wrath) supply the required affinities, and the Corrosion skill's HP cost helps power up her skills that strengthen below 50% HP.
